subject: MAP + Eval Runbook: readiness lanes, approval matrix, and signature timing
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + Eval Runbook: readiness lanes, approval matrix, and signature timing

Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I pulled together a short runbook that aligns the MAP milestones, evaluation checkpoints, and the paper/signature flow so we have a clean go/no-go runway into your June pilot start. Attached: MAP_Orion_v1.pdf and EvalPlan_Orion_v2.xlsx.

High level proposal (very tight):
- Week 0 (now — 10 Mar): finalize security questionnaire + SOC evidence; Redwood will circulate the SOC2 extract and KMS diagram.
- Week 1–2 (11–24 Mar): evaluation window for your infra team (short tests described in EvalPlan). We suggest a 2-week controlled test with pre-populated prompt set to measure latency and cost.
- Week 3 (25 Mar): internal go/no-go checkpoint at Orion — procurement signoff or identified scope/term blockers.
- Week 4 (1 Apr): legal review completion, SOW finalized, signers identified.
- Target signature window: 5–9 Apr.
- Start date: 19 Apr (reserve start-of-week to allow internal onboarding ops).

Can you confirm the following so we can lock the MAP timeline?
1) Who are the two Orc contacts who will run the EvalPlan tests?
2) Is the person who will sign the SOW in the Contracts mailbox (contracts@orionhealth.com) or do we need to route for exec signature?
3) Any procurement PO lead / billing contact we should loop in now?

If that looks good I’ll route the SOW draft for a light legal review with Irene and add the DocuSign window for the 5–9 Apr target.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MAP_Orion_v1.pdf (MAP overview), EvalPlan_Orion_v2.xlsx (test cases), SOW_draft_v3.docx (initial financials)

From: Alex Park <alex.park@orionhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@orionhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval Runbook: readiness lanes, approval matrix, and signature timing

Camila —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers below and a couple of constraints from our side:

1) Eval runners: Myself (Alex Park) and Priya Menon (pri.menon@orionhealth.com). We have ops cycles available 15–26 Mar (we prefer mid-month).
2) Signature: Contracts team typically handles the routing. Our exec signature threshold is $200k — if the SOW is above that, we will need CFO approval (David Hsu). Please indicate estimated ARR to flag if we need exec.
3) Billing: Finance contact is billing@orionhealth.com — they usually want a final SOW + Po number before processing.

Two asks from our procurement lead: can Redwood commit to a 30-day SOC2 evidence delivery SLA once we request the artifact? Also, can you confirm whether the Dedicated offering in the SOW includes a pre-provisioned GPU pool for the pilot?

If you can update the SOW with estimated spend and the SOC2 SLA / Dedicated note I can try to keep the signature window to 5–9 Apr. Otherwise we may slip a week.

Regards,
Alex Park
Director, Cloud Integrations
Orion Health
alex.park@orionhealth.com

> On Mar 1, 2027, at 9:14 AM, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com> wrote:
> 
> > Alex —
> > 
> > Thanks again for the demo last week...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Park <alex.park@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval Runbook: readiness lanes, approval matrix, and signature timing

Putting in the internal approvals matrix here so Alex and Ops have visibility. I’m the AE lead backup for this close. Key points and next steps: 

Approval matrix (who signs what):
- Legal commercial redlines: Irene Choi (legal) will clear non-standard clauses <= 5 business days. Complex indemnity changes route to Head of Legal and will add 3–5 business days.
- Procurement/Contracts acceptance: Contracts Team (contracts@orionhealth.com) — SOW must show price band and optional Dedicated configuration. If estimated 12‑month ARR > $200k, escalate to CFO (David Hsu).
- Executive approval: only needed if escalation threshold met.

Camila — actions from Redwood side:
- Irene, please confirm whether SOW_draft_v3 includes the Dedicated pre-provision note and an optional line item for burst capacity.
- I’ll add a short ‘signature readiness’ checklist to the DocuSign envelope (signers, fallback dates, PO requirement).

Proposed adjusted timeline (based on Alex’s testing window):
- 15–26 Mar: Eval window (Orion runs tests; Redwood provides supporting scripts and a teleconf on day 1).
- 29 Mar: Internal Orion go/no-go checkpoint (we’ll ask for a brief readout).
- 31 Mar: Redwood finalizes SOW and pushes to DocuSign.
- 5 Apr: Primary signer (Contracts team) signs; fallback signer window 5–9 Apr.
- 19 Apr: Startdate (onboarding ops week).

Irene — please weigh in on redline SLAs (SOC2 evidence SLA request). We can offer a 30-day artifact SLA for standard requests; anything requiring additional audit extracts or bespoke evidence will be handled case-by-case.

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: signature_readiness_checklist.xlsx (I'll add to the DocuSign envelope)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Park <alex.park@orionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval Runbook: readiness lanes, approval matrix, and signature timing

Alex / team —

Quick legal review notes after a first pass on SOW_draft_v3.docx:
- Dedicated pre-provision: add an explicit note that Redwood will "reserve" the specified GPU pool for the pilot start date; include a 14-day notice window for changes.
- SOC2 evidence: we can commit to a 30-business-day delivery for standard SOC artifacts once the request is formal. For custom evidence extracts, we will provide scope and timing on request.
- Indemnity: no changes recommended at this stage; if you propose insertion of new indemnity obligations please flag ASAP.
- Data residency and logging: SOW includes an option for EU-only residency; confirm if required.

We’ll make these edits and push SOW_v4 by Tue 9 Mar. If the commercial team needs faster turnaround for a signed SOW in the Apr 5 window, please let us know and we can prioritize.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

> On Mar 3, 2027, at 8:37 AM, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> 
> > Putting in the internal approvals matrix here so Alex and Ops have visibility...

From: Alex Park <alex.park@orionhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@orionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval Runbook: readiness lanes, approval matrix, and signature timing

Team —

This plan is workable. Quick confirmations:
- We will run first-pass Eval tests 15–19 Mar (Alex & Priya). If all green, we’ll expand to the second tranche 22–26 Mar.
- Contracts: please look for the updated SOW_v4 from Redwood on or before Tue 9 Mar. We intend to route in DocuSign and aim for final signature on Tue 6 Apr (Contracts team has reserved that date for the envelope).
- Finance will require a final SOW + PO; I’ll work with billing@orionhealth.com to get the PO during the signing week.

Two items for Redwood: please include the Dedicated pre-provision language and the 30-business-day SOC2 artifact SLA in SOW_v4 so Contracts can approve without escalation. Also add a line item or comment that the pilot is cancellable within 30 days of provisioning with a pro-rata refund for unused committed capacity — that helps our CFO feel comfortable with the commit.

If all of the above lands in SOW_v4 I’ll mark the internal go/no-go as green and we’ll proceed to DocuSign on 6 Apr.

Thanks —
Alex
Director, Cloud Integrations, Orion Health
alex.park@orionhealth.com

--
Forwarded attachments: MAP_Orion_v1.pdf, EvalPlan_Orion_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_v3.docx
